items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you know that clarinet I got from you that time, Millie?

ctx.x: I was winning the tail right away.
Well, you know that clarinet I got from you that time, Millie? Uh-huh. That mouthpiece that was on there, was that the kind that you blew? I mean, that was the mouthpiece that you were using?
